import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    g = x*np.exp(-params[5]*x)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*t + params[2]*t**1.5 + params[3]*t**2 + params[4]*g
            + params[6]*v + params[7]*x + params[8]*x**2 + params[9]*x*v)
